description: 300 failed logins for 'admin' from one external IP in 5 minutes, no successful login.
3 failed logins over an hour from the office network, then a success. User says they typed the wrong password after a holiday.
40 employees received an urgent invoice email from 'paypa1-billing.net'. User meena.r clicked the link and entered credentials.
User reported a suspicious email from 'hr-benefits-update.co' but did not click anything. Email reached 2 mailboxes.
Excel on FIN-APP-02 spawned cmd.exe which ran certutil to download a file from an unknown external site.
PowerShell script restarted IIS on DEV-WEB-01 during approved maintenance window, change ticket CHG-4521.
2,000 files modified and renamed with .encrypted extension; README_DECRYPT.txt ransom note created on the file server.
Nightly backup job modified 5,000 files in the archive folder during the scheduled 02:00 backup window.
Login from Chennai then Frankfurt 20 minutes later. User confirmed she was connected through the company VPN.
Administrator logged in at 3 AM from an external IP never seen before.
Port scan from 10.0.5.20, the approved vulnerability scanner, during its scheduled weekly window.
Internal host 10.0.6.14 scanned ports across 200 servers in 5 minutes. Host is not on the approved scanner list.
External IP scanned all ports on the public web server.
Admin privileges granted to 'dev.intern' at 3 AM, outside any change window, with no ticket.
Admin rights granted to ravi.k under approved change ticket CHG-5001, signed off by his manager, inside the change window.
Administrator RDP login from FIN-APP-02 to the domain controller DC-01. These servers normally never connect to each other.
5 failed logins over 40 minutes from the office network right after a password reset, then one success.
Filter flagged the monthly IT newsletter from it-notices@company.com because of link tracking. Sender verified as internal.
Scheduled task 'MonthlyReport' ran a signed PowerShell script with an encoded command, as it does on the first of every month.
10 failed logins for 'j.smith' from an external IP at 4 AM, followed by a successful login.
One failed login each against 200 different accounts from a single internal host in 10 minutes.
Antivirus detected the EICAR test file on the laptop during the scheduled security awareness training.
Email from 'ceo-urgent@company-payments.com' asked finance to wire money. Priya replied with company bank details.
User changed her own password through the self-service portal with MFA during working hours.
vssadmin deleted all shadow copies on the file server, then 1,500 files were renamed within 3 minutes.
